name: Khelden Bremen
summary: On Northshire Abbey's upper floor, Khelden Bremen teaches human mages their first spells. He prepares novices to serve Stormwind through the arcane arts.

sections.title: Tutor of the Arcane
sections.body: In his study, Khelden Bremen teaches novices the discipline and focus to shape raw magical energy safely. Below, clergy and defenders carry on their work. His pupils prepare to travel through Elwynn Forest and continue their studies in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.answer: Khelden Bremen trains new mages at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He teaches their first spells and the foundations of arcane study.

faq.q: Where can I find Khelden Bremen?
faq.answer: Khelden Bremen is on the second floor of Northshire Abbey. Enter the abbey and take the staircase in the second room on the left.

faq.q: What role does he play for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Human mages arriving in Northshire are directed to Khelden Bremen, often with a Glyphic Letter of introduction. He teaches their first spells and helps them control their magical aptitude.

angles.text: As a human mage, you receive your first formal arcane instruction from Khelden Bremen before continuing your studies in the towers of Stormwind City.
